board.heading: Recent demand worth investigating
board.intro: Ponte identifies recent indications of buyer demand and seller availability through external market research. These are not verified opportunities. Ask Ponte to establish who is behind a signal, whether it is still current, and whether a qualified introduction can be arranged.
board.empty: Selected signals are being reviewed. Nothing is shown here until an administrator has approved it for display.

detail.tombstone: This market signal is no longer active.
detail.actionsNote: Reading this signal needs no account. Ponte contacts nobody and reveals nobody automatically: a request goes to the Ponte desk, and you are asked to join only at the point of sending it.
detail.sectorHeading: Where this sits in the market
detail.commsUnavailable: There is no channel between you and whoever is behind this signal. One would open only after Ponte establishes who they are, they agree to an introduction, and both sides are verified participants. None of that has happened.
detail.registrationNote: Sending an investigation request needs an account. Everything on this page can be read without one.
detail.missingBody: This link does not lead to a market signal. It may have been mistyped, it may have been removed, or Ponte may not have been able to read it just now. Nothing is wrong with your account, and the rest of the market is unaffected.

investigate.intro: Ponte will look into the requirement behind this signal. Your request goes to the Ponte desk; no third party is contacted or revealed automatically.
